label: A Spin Entanglement Witness for Quantum Gravity
summary: Bose and coauthors reported a proposal for a laboratory test in which gravitational interaction between two micron-size test masses could entangle them, with correlations between one embedded spin in each test mass proposed as the entanglement witness.

sources.title: A Spin Entanglement Witness for Quantum Gravity

label: LZ 4.2 tonne-year WIMP search background consistency
summary: In the LUX-ZEPLIN 4.2 tonne-year WIMP dark-matter search, the collaboration reported no evidence for an excess over expected backgrounds after removing artificial signal-like events injected to mitigate analyzer bias.

sources.title: Dark Matter Search Results from 4.2 Tonne-Years of Exposure of the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) Experiment
